note: Conceptual; edge kind 'shown' = demonstrated with ginger material or enzymes in the sources read, 'proposed' = inferred from labelling or gene data, 'chemical' = non-enzymatic.

nodes.label: Phenylalanine
nodes.detail: The amino acid the labelling studies traced into 6-gingerol.

nodes.label: Ferulic acid → feruloyl-CoA
nodes.detail: Made by the phenylpropanoid enzymes, whose activities were found in ginger leaf, shoot and rhizome.

nodes.label: Hexanoyl-CoA + malonyl-CoA
nodes.detail: Hexanoate goes in intact; a longer fatty acid gives 8- or 10-gingerol.

nodes.label: 6-Dehydrogingerdione
nodes.detail: Made by the ginger polyketide synthase ZoPKS2, shown in 2026.

nodes.label: Curcumin-type products (ZoPKS1)
nodes.detail: ZoPKS2's partner ZoPKS1 is a curcumin synthase of the kind turmeric uses.

nodes.label: 6-Gingerol
nodes.detail: Formed by two reductions of the dione, inferred from labelling; the enzymes are not yet shown.

nodes.label: 6-Shogaol
nodes.detail: Forms from gingerol by loss of water on heating and drying; the reaction is reversible in water.
